tagline: A raised, sofa-style edge to prop their chin on and keep an eye on you.
lead: Your dog gets the sofa arm they love, head up and eyes on you, without needing your sofa.
value: Memory foam to lie on and raised sides to rest a head on, in a footprint sized to sit beside your chair.
intro: Elder is a memory foam dog sofa with raised, sofa-style sides to rest a head on, in Medium, Large and XL. The outer cover comes off for machine washing.
points: A memory foam base forms the resting surface.
Sofa-style sides give them somewhere to rest their head and keep watch.
Made to fit next to your chair, so they stay close enough to hear you move.
The outer cover comes off for washing. The foam stays out of the machine.
best_for: Dogs who sleep with their head up on the sofa arm, the step or your foot.
fit_note: Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm. The raised sides take up some of the outside size, so between sizes, size up. Ask us for the XL's exact measurements.
care: Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.
seo_title: Memory Foam Dog Sofa Bed with Sofa-Style Sides | Snoozly
seo_description: A memory foam dog sofa with raised, sofa-style sides for dogs who sleep head up. Medium, Large and XL; the outer cover comes off for machine washing.
